Any failure before step 6 blocks sending. Unknown egress retains its charge (Figures 3 and 5).

SEALED_CHARGED
no further send / no refund
ACKED duplicates return the original receipt. Missing bytes never authorize resampling.
SEALED_CHARGED is an internal terminal marker; remote state may remain unknown.
Conservative first version: all reservations remain charged; state transitions do not add the fee again.
Prompt replacement: Δ₂ ≤ 2C. Noise calibration and finite-precision implementation require review.

Within ε limit: reserve atomically
R(α) ← R(α) + cₜ(α)

reject without sending
Fixed public cost schedule; conditional bounds; no subsampling amplification.

Serialized step commit
KV + token + receipt

UNKNOWN / session invalid
stop; retain charge
NOT_COMMITTED must exclude in-flight work under the same session lock; an empty lookup is insufficient.

private position data

Unapproved raw fields or behavior: block remote release
no raw-text fallback; no guarantee for an unanalyzed channel
